evidence_quotes.O: I'm a headphone buff and I've also had more than a dozen Bluetooth headsets over the years.
evidence_quotes.C: From every specification I've read and every review I've read, these speakers DO sound amazing.
evidence_quotes.E: My main purpose for the webcam was to communicate with my family in another state, in both video and audio. I have to say, mission accomplished.
evidence_quotes.A: I got the MK520 primarily for my parents to use and it suits them pretty well.
evidence_quotes.N: Logitech support wasn't able to help so I finally gave up and decided to try the LifeCam VX-3000.
